content: Rewol bisiy, ifa lepal yai hable le meka spegil chol faluyey rebe daor le ye kkel yai memapelar loh chog ngal Deus!
Be yoh le ibe mel bo yar tugul irel mala ir ye kkel yar hasrowu Deus. Iwe ngo yar medaf irel igegel yar hasrowu Deus mele yete yigil fel.
Re ted gola yalap la yarmat rema fel mo irel Deus iyang. Iwe sa ir chog yar ffaordah chog meka rebe foru le rete dabey yalap la Deus yema hafler yarmat iyang.
Bo Kristus yesa hamolaho molwe kkelel Hatobtob we, ila semal le be tugul lal depal ngo yebe fel mo irel Deus.
Panger Yarmat Ngo Be Yoh Le Rebe Daor
Moses ye tefadiy lal babior kofael yar yarmat be fel mo irel Deus, irel yar dabey yalol Hatobtob we bo, “Semal le yebe dabey yalol Hatobtob le ye sor ngo yebe molow”.

Iwe ngo molwe babior we ye santus ye sor irel yach be fel mo irel Deus irel tugulul ladep iwe ye sor bo: “Ho towe kasiy loh chog llufuluyem hare itey mele yebe loh wol laeng?” (Bo hare bela hasidiy Kristus.)
“Iwe ngo ha towe kasiy bo, itey mele yebe bidiy fael yayulol?” (Bo hare bela hasidah Kristus mo irel maes.)
Mala ye sosor ila iye sengal, “Mala yalol Deus ila ye harepahmi, ye mel irel yami hapatpat ngo ye mel lal dipmi” ila mele kofal tugulul ladep le ha fofoloyu.
Hare ha kaptawey mo lal yawmi le, “Jesus ila iy Samol”, ngo ye tugul lal dipmi le Deus ye hamolowa mo irel maes, ila ngo habe daor.
Be tugul lal depach ngo sibe fel mo irel Deus, iwe ngo sibe kaptawey mo irel yewach ngo sibe daor.
Babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Semal le be yor tugulul lal depal irel, ngo tor mele yebe tayikof depal iyang.”

Mele ila ye hachufengalir panger yarmat bo ye hafidgirloh chog Jews mo Gentiles; bo Deus ila yar panger yarmat Samol, iwe ngo ye palleng yal holbuwar panger rechoka rema ffesangu mala idal bo yebe tipingir.
Iwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Semal le yebe ffesangu mala idel Samol bo yebe tipingi ngo yebe daor.”

Ngo be ifa sengal ngo resa ffesangu le hare yete tugul lal deper irel? Iwe ngo be ifa sengal ngo yesa tugul lal deper le hare reted rongrong mwo semal mala yalol? Ngo be ifa sengal ngo resa rongrong mala yalol hare be tor le yebe foloyu?

Ngo be ifa sengal ngo sala yor le be foloyu le hare tor le re hafdale bo ye bela foloyu? Ila molwe babior we ye santus ye sor bo, “Ye kkel yal momay mala re bela budoh rechokla rema hasidoh hapatpat ka ye momay!”
Ngo te panger yarmat ngo re talenga Hapatpat Momay le. Isaiah ye spegil sor bo, “Samol, itey le ye chepar irel mele yalomem?”
Ila ngo tugulul ladep ila ye budoh mo irel yach rongrong mala yalol Deus, iwe ngo mala yalol ila yebe budoh mo irel yach foloyu kofael Kristus.
Iwe ngo ibe kasiy: Tos le re tarongrong mala yalol? Re rongrong, bo ila molwe babior we ye santus ye sor:

content.text: “Ddigil mekla yalor ila ye mmedarloh lal faileng le,
hapatpat kala re sor ila ye mmedarloh lal pangal ballel faileng le.”

content: Ngo ibe wol kasiya fael sew: Iwe ngo yarmetael Israel re temedaf? Moses mele ye metamol hatefaeli le ye sor bo:

content.text: “Ibe forugmi le habe ngol irer sibis yarmat
le re ted mel bo ir chog chol sew fuluy;
ibele forugmi le habe ssong irel sew faluyel buch.”

content: Iwe ngo Isaiah yesa kkel tot yal hapatpat irel molwe ye sor bo,

content.text: isa llah ngalir rechokwe rete kekasiy ngang.”

content: Iwe ngo irel kofer re Israel ngo sa sor bo, “Sa bongloh wol yai wedwedloh chog bo ibe hakkula ngalir sibis yarmat le retoa hapaliyel ngo re tema talenga hapatpat.”
